notes: West Central Parkway (146 ft) has no median drawn. Its north roadway is labelled (W. N. CANAL) and its south roadway (W. S. CANAL); one centreline is used, lines y ~392/912. Elm and Race both cross it and continue north onto sheet 66. Points on the parkway centreline (y ~650) for streets that stop at it are formal: the actual mouths are at the north line (y ~392) or the south line (y ~905). Two unlabelled openings in the north frontage (sheet 66 side) are recorded as '?' T's: x 1828-1857 (about 8 ft, no main) and x 2378-2411 (about 10 ft, with a water main). Neither is named here; check sheet 66. Two unnamed 10 ft N-S alleys cross the sheet. (1) West alley, x ~1748-1754: printed ALLEY (10') between Grandin and Court; it starts at Grandin Alley (T, no opening north of it), crosses Court, Carter and 9th, is printed ROSS (no suffix, recorded as Ross Alley) between 9th and Andrews, and ends at Andrews (no opening south of it). (2) East alley, x ~2461-2470: runs south from the parkway's south frontage (printed ALLEY in the parkway-Grandin block) across Grandin, Court, Carter and 9th. It is printed PERRY (recorded as Perry Alley) between 9th and Andrews, crosses Andrews and ends at Garfield Place. Its block 1 part (x ~2470) is about 8 px east of the rest. Grandin Alley is offset at Elm: the east part (this sheet's blocks, 10 ft, lines y ~1200/1230) is at y 1215, and the west part (sheet 54 side, lines 1347/1387) is at y 1367; two T's. Carter Alley (10 ft) runs Elm to Race and continues across Race. West of Elm the same line is Richmond Street (24 ft, lines y 2300/2381, centre 2340, sheet 54), so the Elm point (y 2350) is midway between the two arms. Andrews Alley (14 ft, lines y ~3462/3520) runs Elm to Race and crosses Race. Opposite it, west of Elm, sheet 54's unnamed block 9 alley enters at y 3396 (lines 3380/3412), recorded as an Elm T with ''. At Elm the west side is West 8th (lines y 3770/3954) and the east side is Garfield Place (126 ft, lines 3837/4272), recorded as two T's. At Race, Garfield Place is on both sides (cross; the Monument stands in the crossing). Race's east side (sheet 56) has openings matching Grandin, Court, Carter, 9th and Andrews, so those Race points are crossings.
